content.title: Maharashtra Government Sets Up Seven-Member Committee to Frame Air Ambulance SOPs
content.caption: The Maharashtra government has appointed a seven-member committee to develop standard operating procedures for air ambulances and new ambulance services in the state.

slides.heading: Maharashtra Government Sets Up Seven-Member Committee to Frame Air Ambulance
slides.text: The Maharashtra government has appointed a seven-member committee to develop standard operating procedures for air ambulances and new ambulance services in the state.

slides.heading: Committee Formation
slides.text: The committee was formed by the Maharashtra government to develop SOPs for air ambulances and new ambulance services.

slides.heading: Committee Members
slides.text: The committee comprises seven members, including the Transport Minister Pratap Sarnaik, Additional Commissioner of Police (Traffic) Mokshada Patil, and other officials from transport, public health, and police departments.
